Human-AI interaction researchers and practitioners use multiple methods and tools, such as user research, prototyping, testing, and evaluation, to create and improve human-centered AI systems. Deep learning also facilitated new modes of human-AI interaction, such as conversational agents, recommender systems, and social robots. ## What are the Applications of Human-AI Interaction? ### Learn More about Human-AI Interaction ## Questions about Human-AI Interaction What is human-AI interaction?
